run_generate_inference_types: run the generate_inference_types script to check and update inference type files
update_inference_types: update inference types by regenerating __init__.py, main __init__.py, and reference docs with --update flag
generate_reference_package: generate reference package documentation in English or Korean from inference type dataclasses
fix_inference_classes: fix inference class definitions by inheriting from BaseInferenceType and fixing shared class naming
clean_deprecated_fields: remove deprecated classes and fields from inference type modules using libcst
